import numpy as _np  # noqa: E402
import pandas as _pd  # noqa: E402
from dl.dataset import RDDataset as _RDDataset  # noqa: E402
from dl.infer import cfar_valid_mask as _valid_mask, predict_points as _pp  # noqa: E402


def _collect_split_at(model, split, nms_size, device="cpu"):
    """`dl.infer.collect_split`, with nms_size passed through instead of defaulted."""
    ds = _RDDataset(split)
    frames, snrs = [], []
    for fd in ds.frame_dirs:
        mag = _np.load(fd / "rd_map_mag.npy")
        lab = _pd.read_csv(fd / "labels.csv")
        truths = (lab[["range_bin", "velocity_bin"]].to_numpy() if len(lab)
                  else _np.zeros((0, 2)))
        valid = _valid_mask(mag.shape)
        points = _pp(model, mag, valid=valid, nms_size=nms_size, device=device)
        frames.append((points, truths, mag.shape, valid))
        snrs.append(lab["cell_snr_db"].to_numpy() if len(lab) else _np.zeros(0))
    return frames, snrs

substitutions.old: frames, _ = collect_split(model, SPLIT)      # all 1600 frames = all 8 conditions, pooled
substitutions.new: frames, _ = _collect_split_at(model, SPLIT, NMS)   # all 1600 frames, pooled, radius NMS
